slices.focus: The 2028 season produces sustained gains across all measures, and Ayaka's grandmother's feedback — 'inconvenienced, not forgotten' — provides the human proof she needed most.
slices.summary: Ayaka closes the 2028 storm season with repeatable evidence: faster notice updates, cleaner emergency cargo records, steadier recovery after rough-weather days. The improvement holds against the old baseline, not just last year. Her grandmother calls from Shikanoshima and says island residents felt 'inconvenienced, not forgotten' — the human confirmation Ayaka needed most. She prepares a two-page summary (resident impact first, then metrics, then protected practices) and allows herself to count the season as proof that the work changed something real.
